data_fields.name: fast_cast_cap
data_fields.donor_constant: 2 for magery and necromancy, 4 for other skills

best_idea: An interrupted cast locks the caster out for a time that falls as the cast nears completion (1 - sqrt of elapsed over cast time, floor 0.2 s), so a hit at the start of a cast costs the most, which a fast fight can tune as data.
decision_why: Keep the interrupt-lockout curve and the cast-delay-as-data shape, but make the lockout part of the engine's hit step on the one ledger, store the cast delay at cast start, and check reagents and mana before spending either (the donor spends reagents first).
acceptance: In a zone or Pit fight a caster hit at the start of a 0.75 s cast sees a Disrupted cue and a 1.0 s lockout before the next cast; a server test asserts disturbRecoverySec(0, 0.75) == 1.0, disturbRecoverySec(0.6075, 0.75) == 0.2, and that a cast short on mana spends no reagents.
